TEAM / KEVIN DAVISON

KEVIN DAVISON

Hockey Scout

Kevin Davison brings a lifelong passion for hockey and a strong understanding of the game to his role as a Hockey Scout with CADIG Scouting Services.

Having grown up playing minor hockey and later gaining valuable experience as a coach, Kevin understands the game from both the player’s and coach’s perspectives. His background has given him an appreciation for the dedication, development, teamwork, hockey IQ and character required to succeed both on and off the ice.

Kevin has completed training in player scouting and brings a detailed, objective approach to evaluating hockey talent. He looks beyond statistics and focuses on the complete player — skating, skill, hockey sense, compete level, decision-making, work ethic, coachability and overall potential.

Kevin’s strength is recognizing not only what a player can do today, but what that player may be able to become tomorrow. His experience as a former player and coach helps him understand the challenges young athletes face while providing an honest and professional assessment of strengths and areas for development.

As part of CADIG, Kevin is committed to identifying talent, providing accurate player evaluations, and helping players, families, teams and organizations make informed decisions about the next steps in a player’s hockey journey.
